title: bidens frondosa var. pallida
intro: Bidens frondosa var. pallida, commonly known as pale beggarticks, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its reported health benefits of reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bidens frondosa var. pallida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antihistamine activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential uses of this plant.
